message:
Here is an incident from a branch office. Work through it from the evidence.

{"mode":"practice","title":"Branch outage","scenario":{"title":"Branch office cannot reach the data centre","summary":"Since last night's change window, users at the branch cannot open applications hosted in the data centre. Internet access from the branch still works.","symptoms":["Pings from the branch router to 10.20.0.1 time out","The site-to-site tunnel shows no active security association"],"evidence":[{"label":"Branch router","language":"text","content":"BR1# show crypto session
Crypto session current status

Interface: GigabitEthernet0/0
Session status: DOWN
Peer: 203.0.113.10 port 500"}]},"questions":[{"question":"What should you check first?","options":["The IKE phase 1 settings on both peers","The DNS servers of the branch PCs","The access VLAN of the user ports","The default route to the internet"],"answer":"A","explanation":"The session is DOWN with no security association, so the tunnel never formed: compare the IKE phase 1 proposals on both ends."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."}]}
